name: vibe-wise-codex
description: Learn software design with adaptive checkpoints while Codex writes the agreed code.

interface.longDescription: Learn software design while Codex implements agreed changes. Adaptive checkpoints keep trivial edits direct, use one Design checkpoint for familiar bounded changes, and use Build, Design, and Implementation checkpoints for architectural or unfamiliar work. Learning notes stay in the project; invoke the skill to restore context in a new session.
